en.Situation: In my first analyst job, the leave system had seven approvers because nobody had reviewed it since it was built.
en.Task: I was asked to simplify the flow, and I had to interview the people who used it rather than guess from the diagram.
en.Action: I ran five short interviews, drew the current flow, and showed where one approval waited four days for no decision.
en.Result: The flow went to three approvers, and the average request time dropped from six days to two.
en.vague: The leave process was complicated and slow.
en.exaggerated: I redesigned the company's whole HR platform on my own.
en.no_data: After the change, approval was faster.

zh.Situation: 第一份分析工作，請假系統有七個審批人，因為起好之後從來冇人檢視過。
zh.Task: 我要簡化流程，但必須訪談真正用嘅人，而唔係睇圖去估。
zh.Action: 我做咗五次短訪談，畫出現有流程，指出其中一個審批白等四日都冇決定。
zh.Result: 流程減到三個審批人，平均申請時間由六日變兩日。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人重新設計咗公司成個 HR 平台。

en.Situation: At a bank, two departments asked for twelve new fields in a loan application form, and the developer had two weeks.
en.Task: I had to cut the list to something buildable, with reasons each department could accept.
en.Action: I checked which fields were actually used in the last three months of applications, and presented the usage counts to both teams.
en.Result: Five fields had never been read, and we shipped seven with agreement in one meeting.
en.vague: There were a lot of requests for new fields.
en.exaggerated: I cancelled half the bank's requirements by myself.
en.no_data: In the end we built a smaller set of fields and both sides agreed.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行，兩個部門要求貸款申請表加十二個欄位，而開發只有兩星期。
zh.Task: 我要把清單收窄到做得到，並有兩個部門都接受嘅理由。
zh.Action: 我查最近三個月申請實際用了哪些欄位，再把使用次數展示畀兩隊。
zh.Result: 有五個欄位從來冇人睇，最後一個會議就議定做七個。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人取消咗銀行一半需求。
zh.no_data: 最後做咗較少欄位，雙方都同意。

en.Situation: A warehouse team complained that picking was slow, but nobody could say which step was the problem.
en.Task: I was asked to measure the process, and I had to do it without adding work for the pickers.
en.Action: I used the scanner timestamps already recorded, grouped each order by step, and found one scan step took a third of the time.
en.Result: The step was moved off the picker's device, and picking time per order fell by about a fifth.
en.vague: Picking was slow and people were guessing why.
en.exaggerated: I automated the whole warehouse operation.
en.no_data: After the change, picking was quicker.

zh.Situation: 倉務團隊投訴揀貨慢，但冇人講得出係邊一步出事。
zh.Task: 我要量度流程，但唔可以為揀貨同事增加工作。
zh.Action: 我用掃描器本身已記錄嘅時間戳，按步驟分組，發現有一個掃描步驟佔咗三分之一時間。
zh.Result: 該步驟搬離揀貨裝置，每單揀貨時間減少大約五分一。
zh.vague: 揀貨慢，大家都係估原因。
zh.exaggerated: 我自動化咗成個倉庫運作。

en.Situation: Four years in, we had three vendor proposals for a new HR system and the steering group wanted a recommendation in a week.
en.Task: I had to make the comparison fair, and say openly where the scoring was a judgement call.
en.Action: I agreed six weighted criteria with the group first, scored each vendor against evidence from their proposal, and marked the two subjective scores.
en.Result: The group chose the vendor that scored second on price, and the two subjective items were the ones they debated.
en.vague: We had to pick between vendors and it was a long discussion.
en.exaggerated: I chose the company's HR system single-handedly.
en.no_data: In the end the group picked one and the process felt fair.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，新 HR 系統有三間 vendor 提案，督導小組想一星期內有建議。
zh.Task: 我要令比較公平，並公開講清楚邊啲評分係判斷。
zh.Action: 我先同小組議定六個加權準則，再按提案證據逐間評分，並標明兩個主觀分。
zh.Result: 小組揀咗價格排第二嘅 vendor，而爭論集中喺嗰兩個主觀項目。
zh.vague: 要在幾間 vendor 之間揀，討論咗好久。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人決定咗公司嘅 HR 系統。
zh.no_data: 最後小組揀咗一間，過程算公平。

en.Situation: In my internship, I was asked to document the as-is process for a customer complaint flow.
en.Task: I had to write something a new joiner could follow, not a diagram only the author understands.
en.Action: I followed three real complaints end to end, numbered each handover, and wrote what the customer is told at each step.
en.Result: The document was used to train two new staff, and it showed one step where the customer waited with no update for five days.
en.vague: I wrote some documentation about a process.
en.exaggerated: I documented every process in the department.
en.no_data: The document was handed over and people used it.

zh.Situation: 實習時有人叫我記錄客戶投訴流程嘅現況。
zh.Task: 我要寫到新同事跟得到，而唔係只有作者睇得明嘅圖。
zh.Action: 我跟咗三個真實投訴由頭到尾，為每次交接編號，並寫明每一步客戶會收到咩。
zh.Result: 文件用嚟訓練兩位新同事，亦顯示有一步客戶等足五日都冇更新。
zh.exaggerated: 我記錄咗部門所有流程。

en.Situation: At a government-adjacent contractor, business sign-off kept arriving on the last day of the UAT window.
en.Task: I wanted the sign-off to arrive earlier, without pushing the users harder than they could take.
en.Action: I split the sign-off into two checkpoints, gave each user a one-page test list, and booked their time a week ahead.
en.Result: Sign-off arrived two days early in the next cycle, and the two checkpoints caught one blocking issue sooner.
en.vague: Sign-off always came late and it caused pressure.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the contractor's whole delivery governance.
en.no_data: After the change sign-off came earlier.

zh.Situation: 喺政府相關承辦商，業務 sign-off 每次都喺 UAT 窗口最後一日才到。
zh.Task: 我想 sign-off 早啲到，但又唔想逼用戶到佢哋受不了。
zh.Action: 我把 sign-off 分兩個檢查點，每個用戶一頁測試清單，並提早一星期約好時間。
zh.Result: 下個循環 sign-off 早兩日到，兩個檢查點亦更早發現一個阻塞問題。
zh.vague: sign-off 成日都遲，好有壓力。
zh.exaggerated: 我修好咗承辦商成個交付管治。
zh.no_data: 改完之後 sign-off 早咗。

en.Situation: Five years in at an insurer, a claims project had three stakeholders who each believed they had approved a different scope.
en.Task: I had to write one scope everyone would recognise, before the developer wrote more code against guesses.
en.Action: I collected the three versions, marked each difference with the person and date it came from, and ran a single decision meeting.
en.Result: Two differences were genuine and one was a misunderstanding, and the scope was signed the same week.
en.vague: Several stakeholders had different views about the scope.
en.exaggerated: I ended all scope conflicts in the project.
en.no_data: After the meeting the scope was agreed.

zh.Situation: 喺保險公司做咗五年，一個理賠項目有三位 stakeholder，各自以為批咗唔同範圍。
zh.Task: 我要寫出一份大家都認得嘅範圍，趁開發仲未按猜測寫更多 code。
zh.Action: 我收集三個版本，逐項差異標明出自邊個人同日期，再開一次決定會議。
zh.Result: 兩個差異係真，一個係誤會，範圍同一星期簽好。
zh.vague: 幾位 stakeholder 對範圍有唔同睇法。
zh.exaggerated: 我終結咗項目所有範圍衝突。
zh.no_data: 開完會之後範圍議定咗。

en.Situation: In my first role, a user asked for a new report and could not explain what decision it would support.
en.Task: I needed to understand the decision before asking a developer for anything.
en.Action: I asked what she would do differently if the number were high or low, and wrote the answer as a one-line purpose.
en.Result: The request turned out to be a weekly check she could run herself, and no development was needed.
en.vague: A user asked for a report and it was not clear why.
en.exaggerated: I cancelled a project the company had planned for months.
en.no_data: In the end she used something that already existed.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，有位用戶要求新報表，但講唔出支持咩決定。
zh.Task: 我要先明白個決定，然後才向開發提任何要求。
zh.Action: 我問佢數字高或低會令佢做咩唔同嘅事，再把答案寫成一行用途。
zh.Result: 結果發現只係每週自查，佢自己跑得到，完全唔需要開發。
zh.vague: 有用戶要報表，但唔清楚為咩。
zh.exaggerated: 我取消咗公司計劃咗幾個月嘅項目。

en.Situation: At a retail group, the operations team kept asking for a mobile app feature, and the app team kept saying it was out of scope.
en.Task: I sat between them, and I needed a shared view of the cost before anyone decided.
en.Action: I measured how often the task happened per store per week, then put that next to the build estimate in one table.
en.Result: The number was smaller than both sides assumed, and they agreed to solve it with a process change instead.
en.vague: Two teams disagreed about a feature.
en.exaggerated: I prevented a major software project from being built.
en.no_data: In the end both teams agreed on a simpler solution.

zh.Situation: 喺零售集團，營運團隊不停要求 app 加功能，app 團隊就一直話唔喺範圍內。
zh.Task: 我夾喺中間，要喺有人決定之前畀大家一個共用嘅成本觀。
zh.Action: 我量度每間店每星期做幾多次，再同開發估算放埋同一張表。
zh.Result: 數字比雙方估計都細，最後同意用流程改動解決。
zh.vague: 兩隊對一個功能有爭議。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止咗一個重大軟件項目上馬。
zh.no_data: 最後兩隊同意用簡單方案。

en.Situation: Six years in, a failed go-live left the business side refusing to attend any more requirement workshops.
en.Task: I had to rebuild enough trust for one more workshop, and I could not promise a perfect release.
en.Action: I opened with what went wrong, listed the three changes we had made to the process, and asked them to pick the first area to review.
en.Result: They attended, chose a narrow area, and that area went live without a defect in the first week.
en.vague: The business side had lost confidence in the project.
en.exaggerated: I restored the entire relationship with the business single-handedly.
en.no_data: After the workshop, the business side came back to the table.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，一次失敗上線之後，業務方拒絕再參加任何需求工作坊。
zh.Task: 我要重建足夠信任搞多一次工作坊，而唔可以承諾完美上線。
zh.Action: 我一開始就講清楚邊度出事，列出我哋改咗嘅三項流程，再請佢哋揀第一個要檢視嘅範圍。
zh.Result: 佢哋出席，揀咗一個窄範圍，該範圍上線第一星期零 defect。
zh.vague: 業務方對項目失去信心。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人修復咗同業務方成個關係。
zh.no_data: 工作坊之後，業務方返返嚟傾。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I was asked to justify why a manual approval step should stay in a new system.
en.Task: I had to answer with evidence rather than opinion, even though the step had a senior sponsor.
en.Action: I pulled three months of approvals, counted how many were changed at that step, and wrote the count with two examples.
en.Result: The step was kept because four per cent of cases really were corrected there, and the sponsor got a defensible reason.
en.vague: There was a discussion about an approval step.
en.exaggerated: I proved the senior sponsor was right about everything.
en.no_data: In the end the step stayed in the new system.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約期間，有人叫我證明新系統為何要保留一個手動審批步驟。
zh.Task: 我要用證據而唔係意見回答，即使該步驟有位高層支持。
zh.Action: 我抽三個月審批紀錄，數出有幾多喺該步被改，再連兩個例子寫出嚟。
zh.Result: 因為確實有 4% 個案喺該步被改正，步驟保留，而支持者有個站得住腳嘅理由。
zh.vague: 有個關於審批步驟嘅討論。
zh.exaggerated: 我證明咗高層所有講法都對。
zh.no_data: 最後該步驟保留喺新系統。

en.Situation: At a logistics company, a new scanning process was rolled out to nine depots and three of them quietly went back to paper.
en.Task: I was asked to find out why, and to report what I found without softening it.
en.Action: I called the three supervisors, found the scan step added twelve seconds per parcel at their volume, and wrote the finding for the project board.
en.Result: The board changed the step for high-volume depots, and the three depots adopted the system.
en.vague: Some depots did not use the new process.
en.exaggerated: I rolled out the process to every depot successfully.
en.no_data: After the change the depots used the system.

zh.Situation: 喺物流公司，新掃描流程推去九個貨倉，其中三個靜靜雞用返紙。
zh.Task: 我要查出原因，並如實報告而唔修飾。
zh.Action: 我打電話問三位主管，發現以佢哋貨量，掃描步驟每件多十二秒，於是把發現寫畀項目委員會。
zh.Result: 委員會為高貨量貨倉改咗個步驟，三個倉之後採用系統。
zh.exaggerated: 我成功推廣新流程去每個貨倉。
